question: From what distant realms can the desired woman be attracted by this practice?
premises: The practice has the power of attraction.
The desired woman can be drawn quickly.
Even worlds such as that of the nāgas are not beyond reach.
inference: Does it not quickly attract the desired woman, even from the world of nāgas and others?
uncertainties: The rhetorical force of na ākarṣati may imply affirmation.
plain_english: Does it not soon attract the desired woman, even from the world of nāgas and others?
